description: One seamless repeating 64x64 pixel art texture of dark mossy grass and small bare dirt specks seen directly from above. Somber witch cemetery palette muted deep moss green and olive charcoal, no bright greens, no perspective, no objects, no cast shadows, tile fills entire square edge to edge, low contrast so characters stand out. SNES 16-bit crisp pixel clusters, limited 8 color palette, must tile seamlessly left-right and top-bottom.
